correctness.rationale: Generator multisets reduce to multiplicities on the seven nonzero vectors of F₂³. Inclusion-minimal recovery sets are independent and have size at most 3. An independent enumeration checked all rank-3 multiplicity vectors at lengths 3–9: 28,119,329,742,1478,2702,4634 respectively, with no five-all-symbol PIR witness. For the ten-column multiplicity vector 0,1,1,2,2,2,2, independent backtracking serves every one of the 252 five-request multisets.

final_claim: Over F₂, the exact minimum lengths for five-request all-symbol PIR and batch codes of dimension 3 are both 10; no rank-3 length-at-most-9 generator multiset works, while multiplicities 0,1,1,2,2,2,2 give a length-10 batch witness serving all 252 request multisets.
limitations: Finite exact result only for binary dimension 3 and five requests.
